maddeler.e:
ننحذف (form VII)
# نَنْحَذِفُ (nanḥaḏifu) /nan.ħa.ði.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# نَنْحَذِفَ (nanḥaḏifa) /nan.ħa.ði.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# نَنْحَذِفْ (nanḥaḏif) /nan.ħa.ðif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
